name: Storia Stories
original_name: ストーリア・ストーリーズ
source: One day, a white rabbit appears in front of the protagonist and invites her into the world of “Storia”, which is a world full of countries that are based on classic fairy tales. However, the evil "Dream Killers" have stopped these fairy tales from ending in the way they should. If nothing is done, then happy endings will be no more. As the "Girl of destiny", the protagonist is determined to save the world, and goes on an adventure to fix these stories that have been distorted. Will the protagonist see a happy ending?
translation: 有一天，一只白兔出现在主角面前，邀请她进入“故事”的世界，这是一个充满经典童话故事国家的世界。然而，邪恶的“梦杀手”却阻止了这些童话故事的结局。如果什么都不做，那么幸福的结局将不再存在。主角作为“命运之女”，立志拯救世界，并为了修复这些被扭曲的故事而踏上冒险之旅。主角会看到美好的结局吗？
